Address.reason: a link's web address (`composer-link-url`), the network address the remote UI listens on (`remote-settings-bind-address`) and an email address (`common-email-address-short`)

Addresses.reason: a contact's postal addresses (`pim-contact-addresses`), the web addresses the remote UI answers on (`remote-status-urls`) and the email addresses of a key (`security-key-addresses`)

Archive.reason: the Archive folder (`common-folder-archive`, a noun) vs the action that archives a message (`common-archive`, a verb)

Back.reason: navigating back a step (`common-back`) vs moving the free/busy timeline to the previous period (`freebusy-previous-short`)

Call.reason: a tool call in the MCP audit log (`mcp-audit-call`) vs an online meeting call (`invitation-call`)

Change.reason: what a restore changes (`portability-plan-effect`, a noun) vs the button that changes a keyboard shortcut (`customize-keys-actions`, a verb)

Check.reason: which authentication check a rule tests (`rules-auth-method`, a noun) vs the button that checks a recovery key (`security-recovery-verify`, a verb)

Done.reason: the finished state of a task, job or setup (`common-state-done`) vs the button that ends an editing step (`common-done`)

Down.reason: the arrow-down key (`context-menu-key-arrowdown`) vs moving an item down a list (`common-move-down`)

Download.reason: the button that downloads an update (`system-update-download`, a verb) vs what a folder sync downloads (`sync-bodies-label`, a noun)

End.reason: the End key (`context-menu-key-end`) vs the end of a time range (`common-end`)

Event.reason: an entry of the security log (`remote-audit-col-event`) vs a calendar event (`common-event`)

Flag.reason: a message flag (`rules-flag`, a noun) vs the action that flags a message (`common-flag`, a verb)

Folder.reason: a folder on disk (`common-disk-folder`: the data folder, an EML / Maildir import folder) vs a mail folder (`common-folder`)

From.reason: the sender header (`common-header-from`), the start of a time range (`common-range-from`) and where a sign-in came from (`remote-audit-col-origin`)

Keys.reason: the cryptographic keys of the key manager (`security-keys-list`) vs keyboard shortcuts (`customize-keys-key`)

Label.reason: the name of a conference link (`pim-conference-label`) vs a Gmail label (`window-gmail-label-editor`)

Left.reason: the arrow-left key (`context-menu-key-arrowleft`) vs the left drop zone of the layout editor (`layout-editor-zone-left`)

Message.reason: the text of a message (`common-message-body`, the body field) vs a message as an item (`common-message`)

Next.reason: the next step of a wizard (`security-recovery-next`) vs the next period of a calendar or timeline (`common-next-period`)

Read.reason: a read access in the MCP audit log (`mcp-audit-kind-resource`) vs the read state of a message (`action-field-read`)

Restore.reason: restoring a maximized window's size (`window-manager-restore`) vs restoring a backup (`common-restore`)

Right.reason: the arrow-right key (`context-menu-key-arrowright`) vs the right drop zone of the layout editor (`layout-editor-zone-right`)

Role.reason: an attendee's role in a meeting (`pim-attendee-role`: chair, required, optional) vs a contact's role in an organization (`pim-contact-role`)

Runs.reason: how often a plug-in job ran (`plugin-activity-runs`, a count) vs where a rule runs (`exchange-rules-placement`)

Schedule.reason: the composer's button that schedules a send (`composer-schedule`, a verb) vs a schedule as the cause of a run (`common-schedule`, a noun)

Search.reason: the label of a search field (`common-search-noun`, a noun) vs the action / button that searches (`common-search`, a verb)

Security.reason: the connection security (TLS mode) of a server (`server-tls`) vs the Security group of the settings page (`settings-group-security`)

Sending.reason: the section about sending identities of a virtual account (`virtual-identities`) vs the outbox state of a message being sent (`outbox-state-sending`)

Sent.reason: the Sent folder (`common-folder-sent`) vs the outbox state of a sent message (`outbox-state-sent`)

Server.reason: the host name field of a server (`common-server`) vs where Sieve rules run (`sieve-placement-server`, "on the server" as opposed to "in Nail")

Show.reason: the label in front of a filter choice (`common-show`, "Show: ...") vs the visibility value of a Gmail label (`common-visibility-show`)

Source.reason: where a key came from (`security-key-source`) vs the HTML source view of the composer (`composer-format-source-short`)

Text.reason: the text view of the rule editor (`rules-view-text`) vs a text value (`action-field-body`)

To.reason: the recipient header (`common-header-to`) vs the end of a date range (`print-agenda-end`)

Up.reason: the arrow-up key (`context-menu-key-arrowup`) vs moving an item up a list (`common-move-up`)

Updates.reason: Gmail's Updates category (`gmail-category-updates`) vs Nail's own updates (`common-updates`)

Where.reason: the part of the window a keyboard shortcut works in (`customize-keys-context`) vs the location of an event (`common-where`)
